value.rationale: The full-dimensional Euclidean bipyramid is a canonical symmetric reference element with tips and equatorial faces. Exact L∞ amplification of its L2 affine regression operator directly quantifies worst possible sup-norm instability and loss of positivity, relevant to polynomial approximation on pointed cells. The theorem gives all dimensions, strict tip-only norming geometry for d>=2, sharp positive-input overshoot and linear dimensional growth. The apex-vs-equator rigidity is nontrivial and not a simple substitution of the one-sided cone or simplex formula.
